fit_reason: A whole Alumacraft aluminum canoe listed by a private owner in boats by owner. It is a boat, though bare aluminum leaves little for a detail to work on.
findings: Light water spots and smudges on the aluminum bottom, visible in the overhead hull shot
Dull, uneven sheen on the aluminum hull sides near the Alumacraft decal
Light dirt and grime along the bow edge and rivet line
Interior of the canoe is not shown, so its condition can't be judged
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Alumacraft Voyager canoe. The hull looks to be in good shape, though the photos pick up some water spotting on the bottom and a bit of dullness along the sides. We do mobile pre-sale cleaning and polishing that could bring the aluminum back to a more even shine before you show it. Would you like a quote?
